title: Email: Fw: Try to attend tomorrow ...

content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Bhatia, Peter <pbhatia@gannett.com>
Sent: Tuesday, August 18, 2020 8:48 PM
To: DFP_Everybody <DFP_Everybody@freepress.com>
Subject: Try to attend tomorrow ... 
 
Maribel is having a news division all-hands meeting tomorrow at 2. It would be worth your time to attend if your schedule permits. She will be announcing a major diversity initiative that includes a diversity audit of the company. Results of that will be released. We will post the Freep audit results on Thursday morning to be printed on Sunday. The audit will show our news staff is 27.7 percent people of color, with some new hires (to be announced shortly) pushing it higher. I've written a column to post Thursday that reports the numbers and documents why we need to do better.
